Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial illustration for a premium Mercedes workshop website.
Reference role: use the provided workshop image for the warm wood reception materials, graphite palette, subdued red accents and realistic soft lighting only.
Primary request: an elegant overhead photograph of a walnut service desk where a pair of anonymous adult hands is reviewing a completely unbranded blank work-order sheet. One hand rests beside the paper and the other points calmly toward a faint ruled area. No face visible. Beside the paper are a refined black-and-silver Mercedes car key and a small distinct set of clean proposed parts neatly arranged on a small graphite felt mat: two new brake pads and a compact circular gasket. Keep the objects separate, purposeful and realistically sized. Plain white paper with a few very faint gray rules but absolutely no words, signatures, amounts, personal data, letterhead or logos. Sleeves are understated charcoal smart casual fabric.
Style and composition: premium realistic automotive editorial still life, overhead camera, spacious controlled arrangement, natural hand anatomy and materials, landscape 16:9 about 1672 x 941. Soft natural side light, walnut grain, graphite, silver and a tiny restrained dark red accent. No caption, watermark or border. No coffee, drinks, tablet, laptop or crowded tools. No claims about suppliers or authenticity.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: refined editorial automotive still life for a premium Mercedes workshop website.
Reference role: the workshop photograph is the palette, materials and natural-light reference only.
Primary request: a refined contemporary black-and-silver Mercedes car key resting on a closed dark leather service folder on the passenger seat of a modern Mercedes. The folder is completely plain, with no writing, embossing, sticker or label. Seat upholstery is rich graphite perforated leather with precise stitching. Show a subtle warm walnut trim sliver and restrained dark red ambient lighting at the door edge. View obliquely through the open passenger doorway, focusing intimately on the key and folder with believable leather texture, shallow natural depth of field. A faint blurred glass-and-steel workshop reflection gives continuity to the reference setting. Different composition from an overhead service-desk scene. No hands, no people, no documents exposed, no readable screen or dashboard text, no receipts, no coffee.
Style: realistic premium automotive editorial photography, quiet soft natural side light, graphite, silver and warm wood, subtle red. One landscape 16:9 photo approximately 1672 x 941, no captions, watermark or border. Recognizable Mercedes star on the key is fine; no other logos or text.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium automotive editorial process photograph, an illustration of reviewing parts options with no supplier claim.
Reference roles: workshop image defines graphite steel workbench, lighting and material palette. Team image defines black workwear with fine dark red piping only. No face or identity should be visible.
Primary request: close oblique overhead view of a technician's two naturally proportioned hands in clean black work gloves comparing two new clean cartridge oil filters in two separate open plain boxes on a tidy graphite workbench. Each hand lightly steadies one filter in its box. Use realistic pleated filter media and simple dark end caps. The two filters have subtly distinct construction details, both plausible and clean, with no branding or quality verdict implied. Packaging is tasteful plain light gray and natural cardboard, entirely unlabelled, with no barcodes, printing or supplier logos. Hands and forearms only in charcoal workwear sleeves with fine red piping. Background is softly blurred dark workshop with faint red lift metal and warm natural side light, consistent with the reference.
Style: realistic premium automotive editorial photography, material detail, calm comparison composition, graphite, silver, warm cardboard and subtle red. One landscape 16:9 image approximately 1672 x 941. No text, captions, stars, checkmarks, labels, watermark, border, dirty oil, coffee, tablet or additional loose parts. Do not suggest either part is a genuine branded supplier item.
